menu_options.health: Monitor the installed app health without credentials

app.title: Find the Downloads app
app.description: Start the Downloads app, then try again.

standalone.title: Connect Downloads
standalone.description: Use the native service origin and its dedicated integration token, never an ingress URL or a Home Assistant token.

hassio_confirm.title: Pair Downloads
hassio_confirm.description: Connect to the discovered Downloads app. Media requests stay disabled until enabled in the integration options.

health.title: Connect Downloads health
health.description: Select the installed Downloads app. This read-only health connection needs no address or token. Media pairing can be added later through Reconfigure.

error.app_not_found: No Downloads app discovery was found.
error.supervisor_required: App pairing requires Home Assistant Supervisor. Use a native origin instead.
error.supervisor_unavailable: Cannot read app discovery from Supervisor.
error.multiple_apps: More than one Downloads app was discovered.
error.integration_required: Use a dedicated Downloads integration token, not a read-only, requester, or administrator token.
error.invalid_url: Enter one HTTP(S) origin without credentials, a path, query, or fragment.

abort.invalid_discovery: The app discovery information is invalid.
abort.already_configured: This Downloads app is already configured.
abort.supervisor_required: Native app health requires Home Assistant Supervisor.
abort.supervisor_unavailable: Supervisor could not be reached. Try again later.
abort.app_not_found: Install and start the Downloads app before adding its health connection.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The discovered app is not the app already paired to this entry.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Downloads media pairing updated. Existing health identity and exposure were preserved.

init.title: Media request access
init.description: Allow permitted HA users and automations to submit media requests. Assist also requires explicit exposure of the Downloads stack health entity. No settings changes, deletion, release overrides, or VPN controls are exposed.

abort.media_not_paired: Use Reconfigure on the Downloads integration to pair media features first. Native health continues without media credentials.

search.name: Search media
search.description: Resolve titles to canonical IDs and native request availability without requesting a download.

request.name: Request media
request.description: Submit the exact movie or TV request with a caller-owned idempotency key. Acceptance is not download completion.

status.name: Read media status
status.description: Read a request, original idempotency key, movie, or TV status without retrying a write.

imports.name: Read recent imports
imports.description: Read completed imports from Radarr and Sonarr with separate Plex and subtitle evidence. Includes media requested directly in those apps.

health_failed.title: {component} needs attention
health_failed.description:
The last verified Downloads check reported: **{codes}**.

Open [Downloads logs]({logs_url}) and the affected service's native settings. [Downloads integration and diagnostics]({integration_url}) provides the current connection state and a diagnostic download.

This issue clears after a fresh check confirms the failure has cleared. A stale or unavailable check does not prove recovery. No settings, queues, or devices are changed by this Repair.

health_unavailable.title: {component} cannot be verified
health_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant cannot obtain current health evidence: **{codes}**. This does not prove that the VPN or another service has failed. Previously confirmed failures remain unresolved until a fresh check confirms recovery.

Check [Downloads logs]({logs_url}) and [the integration connection and diagnostics]({integration_url}). This issue clears when current health evidence is available again.
